literal_meaning: মাথায় ঘোল ঢালা (head on mud pour)
similar_in_english: To put someone in their place
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে মাথায় ঘোল ঢেলে অপমান করল।
পুলিশ চোরটাকে মাথায় ঘোল ঢেলে ছেড়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He humiliated his rival by pouring mud on his head.
The police let the thief go after pouring mud on his head.
history: The idiom draws from a traditional practice of humiliating wrongdoers by pouring mud or dirt on their head as a form of public shaming before release.
note: The expression is often used in contexts of verbal or social defeat.
